Gradient Generator

Design beautiful CSS gradients with two color pickers and an angle slider. Preview it live, then copy the ready-to-use linear-gradient CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick your two gradient colors.
  2. Drag the angle slider or choose a direction.
  3. Watch the live preview update.
  4. Click Copy CSS to paste the gradient into your project.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does the angle control?

The angle sets the direction of the gradient — 0deg goes bottom to top, 90deg goes left to right, and 135deg runs diagonally.

Will the CSS work in all browsers?

Yes. The generated linear-gradient syntax is supported by every modern browser on desktop and mobile.

Can I make a gradient with more than two colors?

This tool makes clean two-color gradients. You can extend the copied CSS yourself by adding more color stops to the linear-gradient() function.
